name: Wang An-shih
bio: Wang An-shih (AD 1021–1086) was a Sung statesman and reformer, and also a poet.
The poems here are Herbert A. Giles’s versions in Chinese Poetry in English Verse (1898), given with the poet’s name as spelled in that book.

poems.title: A White Night
poems.author: Wang An-shih
poems.text:
The incense-stick is burnt to ash, the water-clock is stilled,
The midnight breeze blows sharply by and all around is chilled.
Yet I am kept from slumber by the beauty of the spring:
Sweet shapes of flowers across the blind the quivering moonbeams fling!

poems.title: At the Parting Ways
poems.author: Wang An-shih
poems.text:
The west wind ruffles the water
Where the last red blossoms fade,
And the thought of separation
Is stirred by the lute's serenade.
East of the world-piled hills
Our song of parting thrills.

poems.title: 桂枝香 (Gui zhi xiang)
poems.author: Wang An-shih
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
登临送目。
正故国晚秋，天气初肃。
千里澄江似练，翠峰如簇。
归帆去棹残阳里，背西风、酒旗斜矗。
彩舟云淡，星河鹭起，画图难足。
念往昔、繁华竞逐。
叹门外楼头，悲恨相续。
千古凭高，对此漫嗟荣辱。
六朝旧事随流水，但寒烟、芳草凝绿。
至今商女，时时犹唱，後庭遗曲。

poems.title: 千秋岁引 (Qian qiu sui yin)
poems.author: Wang An-shih
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
别馆寒砧，孤城画角。
一派秋声入寥廓。
东归燕从海上去，南来雁向沙头落。
楚台风，庾楼月，宛如昨。
无奈被些名利缚。
无奈被他情担阁。
可惜风流总闲却。
当初漫留华表语，而今误我秦楼约。
梦阑时，酒醒後，思量著。

poems.title: 清平乐 (Qing ping yue)
poems.author: Wang An-shih
poems.collection: 宋詞三百首 (Three Hundred Song Lyrics)
poems.text:
留春不住。
费尽莺儿语。
满地残红宫锦污。
昨夜南园风雨。
小怜初上琵琶。
晓来思绕天涯。
不肯画堂朱户，春风自在杨花。

poems.title: 春夜 (Chun ye)
poems.author: Wang An-shih
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
金爐香燼漏聲殘，剪剪輕風陣陣寒。
春色惱人眠不得，月移花影上欄杆。

poems.title: 元日 (Yuan ri)
poems.author: Wang An-shih
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
爆竹聲中一歲除，春風送暖入屠蘇。
千門萬戶曈曈日，總把新桃換舊符。

poems.title: 北山 (Bei shan)
poems.author: Wang An-shih
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
北山輸綠漲橫陂，直塹回塘灩灩時。
細數落花因坐久，緩尋芳草得歸遲。

poems.title: 晚樓閒坐 (Wan lou xian zuo)
poems.author: Wang An-shih
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
四顧山光接水光，憑欄十里芰荷香。
清風明月無人管，並作南來一味涼。

poems.title: 茅檐 (Mao yan)
poems.author: Wang An-shih
poems.collection: 千家詩 (Poems of a Thousand Poets)
poems.text:
茅檐常掃淨無苔，花木成蹊手自栽。
一水護田將綠繞，兩山排闥送青來。
